rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Constitutional Court Chairman V. D. Zorkin states that on assuming office the President takes the oath set by the Constitution and asks Putin to take it; Putin recites the oath.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Zorkin then declares that Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin has assumed the office of President of the Russian Federation; the anthem follows and the announcer introduces 'President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin'.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The broadcast narrator calls this Putin's re-election and says that on 14 March more than 71 percent of those who took part voted for him.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The narrator says Putin first took the presidential oath on 7 May 2000 and that four years have passed.
